verdict.rationale: Graphite is a developer-workflow SaaS that could plausibly publish versioned APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented public API versioning scheme or deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. A CLI version number (gt 1.8.4) is an adjacent fact, not a versioned API with a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
